messages:
Maya (HelioApps): Hey team, onboarding warmup started and we see intermittent 401s from the Node SDK plus periodic 429 bursts right after we scale workers. Happens in staging only. Anyone seen similar?
Omar (CSM): @Maya thanks — can you share SDK version, minimal logs, and whether tokens are minted by your CI or a service? Looping in @Jin and @Felipe.
Maya (HelioApps): SDK v2.0.3. Log snippet: 
```
POST /v1/embeddings 401 { id: \"req_aa12...\", error: \"unauthorized\", hint: \"missing auth header\" }
```
But our CI env shows Authorization present. Also: lots of 429s with `Retry-After: 0`.
Jin (SDK): two likely culprits: header forwarding loss (proxies/lambdas) and aggressive client retry behavior when Retry-After is 0. Which runner infra are you using?
Maya (HelioApps): GH Actions self-hosted runners calling an edge-worker lambda that fans out requests via fetch().
Felipe (SRE): lambda runtimes sometimes strip or fail to forward Authorization on internal fetch calls if middleware isn't configured. Also short-lived tokens with tight TTLs + parallel boot can look like 401 spikes. Can you paste token payload (sanitized)?
Maya (HelioApps): sanitized token: `\{"iat\":1700000000,\"exp\":1700000060,\"scopes\":[\"embeddings.read\"]\}` TTL 60s, only read scope. We do batch writes during onboarding though.
Omar (CSM): scope explains 403 for write-required endpoints — but your log said 401 missing header. So two things: scope and header. Jin, any known SDK flags to help?
Jin (SDK): v2.0.3 has a `fallbackAuth` helper but it's opt-in. Also v2.0.4 patched retry to respect Retry-After but only when `respectRetryAfter: true`. Workarounds: 1) ensure token has required scopes (embeddings.write) 2) increase TTL to >=5m for parallel fanout or implement per-worker refresh 3) set `retry: { respectRetryAfter: true, maxAttempts: 4, minTimeout: 300 }` and add client-side jitter/splay when starting workers.
Maya (HelioApps): we'll add embeddings.write and increase TTL. Our lambda uses a header whitelist middleware that might be filtering Authorization on internal requests — checking now.
Felipe (SRE): i'll look at traces. If I see `x-edge: lambda-proxy` and empty authorization at the edge, that's the header-strip path. Also, time skew can break short TTLs; ensure runners have ntp sync.
Maya (HelioApps): confirmed middleware dropped Authorization on internal fanout. Whitelisted it and bumped token TTL to 5m. Also added a 0..250ms randomized splay on worker start.
InfraBot: Ops request created: OPS-4310 — "HelioApps onboarding temporary quota bump" assigned to infra-ops.
Maya (HelioApps): re-ran 4 warmups: 401s disappeared, 429s reduced from ~18% to ~2%. Looks good so far.
Jin (SDK): great — follow-up: we'll backport the Retry-After respect fix to v2.0.x and add a short note in onboarding docs about token TTLs and header forwarding. I'll open PRs.
Omar (CSM): Action list: 1) Maya — ensure embeddings.write scope + TTLs (done) 2) Maya — keep splay in warmup (done) 3) Jin — patch SDK docs + backport retry fix 4) Felipe — monitor traces for 24h. I'll keep OPS-4310 open for 48h.
Felipe (SRE): tracing note: if you must keep short TTLs, implement token exchange (one long-lived per runner -> short-lived per request) to avoid stampedes.
Maya (HelioApps): thanks all. Will report if anything resurfaces. Closing for now. :wave:
